adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 re-review reopened the handoff packet, XML/PDF/SI assets, OOXML supplement, locator index, linked DBAASP rows, and merged sequence/assay snapshots. DBAASP activity/FICI rows now match primary Tables 1-3, the existing full-source-review ticket is closed, and the final outputs remain accepted with cautions because the primary paper reports C-terminally amidated A11 while the merged plain sequence snapshot omits the terminal amidation.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Linked DBAASP assay/experiment rows are source-reconciled against Tables 1-3. Activity/FICI values are source-supported; all A11 activity rows retain sequence_modified_not_normalized because the primary paper reports WVKKVARKVVKIGRKVAR-NH2 while the merged sequence snapshot is the unmodified plain amino-acid string.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: A11 MIC/MBC, clinical isolate MIC/MBC ranges, checkerboard FICI/interpretion rows, and supplementary A11/TAMRA-A11/biofilm evidence were rebuilt from source locators with raw units and values preserved. Comparator-only antibiotic/melittin MIC/MBC values were checked but not promoted as AMP records except where part of A11 combinations.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are separated into direct membrane/translocation/DNA-binding evidence and supportive proteomics context; omics pathway changes are not promoted to direct binding claims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review_gate: The prior full_source_review_not_completed/database_conflicts_require_adjudication ticket is closed by source-reviewed row matching; remaining caution is nonblocking and explicit.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary paper source gives A11 as WVKKVARKVVKIGRKVAR-NH2, while the merged DBAASP sequence snapshot stores WVKKVARKVVKIGRKVAR; terminal amidation is preserved as a caution rather than silently normalized.

Packet material status remains with gaps from the framework layer, but the local XML, PDF text, OA package, supplement PDF, supplement XLSX, locator index, and database snapshots needed for worker-4/6 gate closure were reopened and sufficient.
